title: setup: pin LF line endings for .agentboard in target repos
description: HANDOVER §3.4: with core.autocrlf=true, .agentboard JSON can be checked out with CRLF; hashes differ from what the tool writes and edits rewrite to LF. Have setup add /.agentboard/** eol=lf (or -text) to the target's .gitattributes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: setup adds the rule idempotently, preserving existing .gitattributes content
